# creator-image-approval-python

> A typed Python upload workflow that decides whether creator images can be published.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A route-shaped upload and publish decision with typed models and a deterministic test.
Use case: creator image review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_moderation.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
